chopin.data 0.0.1
  • Reference

    Sediment characteristics and contaminant concentrations

    sed_contam.Rd

    Sediment samples collected during the CHOPIN project, including sampling information, sediment physicochemical characteristics, grain-size distribution, and concentrations of PCBs, PFASs, and HBCDD isomers.

    Format

    A tibble with 24 rows and 247 variables. Each row represents one sediment sample. Variables include:

    year

    Numeric. Sampling year.

    season

    Factor. Sampling season, with levels "spring" and "autumn".

    zone

    Character. Sampling area within the Seine estuary: "Embouchure", "Fosse Nord", or "Fosse Sud".

    type

    Character. Sample type. All observations in this dataset correspond to "sediment" samples.

    site

    Character. Sampling-site identifier.

    sample_TAG

    Character. Unique sample identifier used in the CHOPIN project.

    lat

    Character. Latitude of the sampling location, recorded in degrees and decimal minutes.

    lon

    Character. Longitude of the sampling location, recorded in degrees and decimal minutes.

    date

    POSIXct. Sampling date in UTC.

    hour

    Character. Sampling-time information as recorded in the original dataset.

    Corg_percent

    Numeric. Organic carbon content of the sediment, expressed as a percentage of sediment dry weight.

    N_percent

    Numeric. Nitrogen content of the sediment, expressed as a percentage of sediment dry weight.

    Corg_ng_g

    Numeric. Organic carbon content expressed on a sediment-mass basis. See Details regarding the unit encoded in the variable name.

    Norg_mg_g

    Numeric. Organic nitrogen content, expressed in mg per g of sediment.

    Corg_mol

    Numeric. Organic carbon content expressed on a molar basis.

    Norg_mol

    Numeric. Organic nitrogen content expressed on a molar basis.

    C_over_N_mol

    Numeric. Molar carbon-to-nitrogen ratio of sediment organic matter.

    0-63

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 0–63 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    63_125

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 63–125 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    125_250

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 125–250 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    250_500

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 250–500 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    500_750

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 500–750 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    750_1000

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 750–1000 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    1000_2000

    Numeric. Percentage of sediment particles in the 1000–2000 micrometre grain-size fraction.

    loss_of_ignition_percent

    Numeric. Sediment loss on ignition, expressed as a percentage.

    Ctot_mg_g

    Numeric. Total carbon concentration, expressed in mg per g of sediment.

    Cmineral_mg_g

    Numeric. Mineral carbon concentration, expressed in mg per g of sediment.

    porosity_percent

    Numeric. Sediment porosity, expressed as a percentage.

    water_percent

    Numeric. Sediment water content, expressed as a percentage.

    _ng_gdw

    Numeric. Concentration of an individual PCB congener, PFAS compound, or HBCDD isomer, expressed in ng per g sediment dry weight (ng g^-1 dw). Chemical identifiers correspond to those defined in contam_info.

    _ng_gCorg

    Numeric. Concentration of an individual PCB congener, PFAS compound, or HBCDD isomer normalized to sediment organic carbon content, expressed in ng per g organic carbon.

    sum_PCB_ng_gdw, sum_PFAS_ng_gdw, sum_HBCDD_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of the concentrations of the compounds included in each contaminant family, expressed in ng per g sediment dry weight.

    sum_PCB_ng_gCorg, sum_PFAS_ng_gCorg, sum_HBCDD_ng_gCorg

    Numeric. Sum of the concentrations of the compounds included in each contaminant family after normalization to sediment organic carbon, expressed in ng per g organic carbon.

    _normalised_sum_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Relative contribution of an individual compound to the summed concentration of its contaminant family, calculated from dry-weight concentrations. Values are proportions and are therefore dimensionless despite the historical variable suffix.

    _normalised_sum_ng_gCorg

    Numeric. Relative contribution of an individual compound to the summed concentration of its contaminant family after organic-carbon normalization. Values are proportions and are therefore dimensionless despite the historical variable suffix.

    Source

    CHOPIN project sediment sampling and analytical dataset.

    Details

    Contaminant concentrations are provided both on a dry-weight basis and normalized to sediment organic carbon content. The dataset also contains summed concentrations by contaminant family and the relative contribution of individual compounds to their corresponding family sum.

    Individual contaminant variables include PCB congeners, PFAS compounds, and the alpha-, beta-, and gamma-HBCDD isomers. Chemical identifiers and their associated families and display labels are provided in contam_info.

    Concentrations ending in _ng_gdw are expressed relative to sediment dry weight, whereas variables ending in _ng_gCorg are normalized to sediment organic carbon.

    Variables containing normalised_sum represent the relative contribution of each individual compound to the total concentration of its contaminant family rather than contaminant concentrations themselves.

    Zero values in contaminant variables are retained as provided in the analytical dataset and should not automatically be interpreted as true absence without considering the analytical detection and quantification limits provided in contam_info.
